title: Hard-bound: source-resident and batched Q8_0 after up-skip overhead profile

baseline_inference.method: Assumes other run components are comparable; CPU up fallback replaced is approximated as q80_profile_total - observed_wall_regression.
baseline_inference.implication: Any replacement for all-up CPU fallback must be well below about 8.4s to beat SOTA; current Q8_0 replacement is 58.7s.

rejected_designs.name: persistent cudaMalloc/cudaFree buffers only
rejected_designs.reason: Saves far less than the roughly 50s regression and leaves host src0 copy, H2D, and synchronized kernels intact.

rejected_designs.name: source-resident/H2D elimination only
rejected_designs.reason: Still leaves about 24.5s of Q8_0 path time, mostly kernel_sync, before considering remaining down fallback.

rejected_designs.name: up-only hotset source residency with current per-call kernel
rejected_designs.reason: Hotset source residency can remove a large source-copy bucket for covered up calls, but current per-call kernel_sync remains too expensive and up-only cannot reach 10 tok/s.

possible_but_not_yet_implemented.name: source-resident batched/fused Q8_0 hot up path
required_properties: Keep hot up payload resident or otherwise avoid repeated full src0 host copies.
Batch multiple expert rows per layer/token to avoid one cudaDeviceSynchronize per expert call.
Keep CPU-compatible arithmetic or prove token-level stability with fixed-text top1 before performance.
Preserve accepted gate cache or show a new VRAM allocation bound.
possible_but_not_yet_implemented.scope_limit: Potential small SOTA candidate only. Up-only hotset does not solve 10 tok/s; down correctness and batching are still required.

next_correctness_step.decision: revisit down correctness with CPU-compatible arithmetic before designing all-up/all-down performance
next_correctness_step.reason: The previous down rejection happened before CPU-compatible arithmetic fixed the up boundary. Down is still required for a 10 tok/s path.
next_correctness_step.required_source_guard: Any down test must be behind an explicit default-off env gate; current code deliberately restricts q80 write/skip to ffn_up_exps.
